Cryptocurrency Mining Pool

Mine Bitcoin, Bitcoin Cash, Kaspa, Ethereum Classic, Zcash, Ravencoin, and 20+ other coins on 2Miners — a mining pool running since 2017. POOL and SOLO modes available for every coin. Low-latency servers across Europe, North America, and Asia with 99.9% uptime and DDOS protection.

  • 24330 miners worldwide are mining on 2Miners right now — one of the largest active communities in crypto mining.
  • Pool fee is 1.0% for POOL and 1.5% for SOLO — among the lowest in the industry. The rest goes directly to miners.
  • Payouts are automatic every 2 hours, around the clock. No manual withdrawal, no waiting, no missed payments.
  • In the last 24 hours, 2Miners distributed $105,108 to miners across all pools.

High Availability

Dedicated servers — not cloud instances — in Europe, US, Asia. DDOS protection on every node. Stratum endpoints with consistently low ping: Stockholm 24 ms, Helsinki 30 ms, Warsaw 31 ms, Berlin 34 ms. No single point of failure.

Nicehash Compatible

Dedicated stratum port, 100% compatible with Nicehash stratum protocol. 2Miners is an officially recommended Nicehash pool. Connect your rig without any additional configuration.

Rig Monitoring

Know immediately when a worker goes offline or a new block is found. Alerts via Telegram bot, email, and the 2Miners mobile app for iOS and Android — free for any number of rigs.

Help from real humans

Telegram Chat
@chat2miners

Community 24/7 Support: 12 000+ miners are chitchatting

Helpdesk
helpdesk.2miners.com

An outstanding knowledge base for miners

Latest updates

13 November 2026

We've added Bitcoin and Toncoin payout options to our Pearl PPLNS and SOLO pools alongside PRL, with minimal fees under $0.2 for BTC and $0.02 for TON.

11 November 2026

We've discontinued BTC payouts on our Nexa PPLNS and SOLO pools—now only NEXA payouts are available; switch to a Nexa address or mine another coin on 2CryptoCalc.

6 November 2026

We're delisting Bitcoin Gold (BTG) on November 7 at 11:00 UTC due to lack of exchanges, unprofitability, and server strain; use 2CryptoCalc to find profitable alternatives.

6 November 2026

We've activated the Zcash Network Upgrade NU7, reducing block time from 75 to 25 seconds and block rewards from 1.25 to 0.416667 ZEC while maintaining daily emission; mining runs normally with payouts resuming after network stability confirmation.
